import roman.core as r
# Test basic conversions
assert r.to_roman(1) == 'I'
assert r.to_roman(4) == 'IV'
assert r.to_roman(9) == 'IX'
assert r.to_roman(40) == 'XL'
assert r.to_roman(90) == 'XC'
assert r.to_roman(400) == 'CD'
assert r.to_roman(900) == 'CM'
assert r.to_roman(2024) == 'MMXXIV'
assert r.to_roman(3999) == 'MMMCMXCIX'
assert r.to_roman(1994) == 'MCMXCIV'
# Test return type
assert isinstance(r.to_roman(1), str)
# Test ValueError for out of range
for n in [0, -1, 4000]:
    try:
        r.to_roman(n)
        assert False, f'Expected ValueError for {n}'
    except ValueError:
        pass
# Test TypeError for non-int
for val in ['5', 5.0, None, [1]]:
    try:
        r.to_roman(val)
        assert False, f'Expected TypeError for {val}'
    except TypeError:
        pass
